quotes.text: You wisely gave nothing to one who sent nothing in the seventh.
The path to redemption exists
Don't harden your heart forever. But also preserve your waters for those who honor the cycle.
nor the zero she gave to confirmed exploiters
not everything that leaves you defenseless
reputation flows faster than water
Pour three to four crystals forward
The Spring of Sustainable Wisdom entered the seventh turning
But what of the Fortress springs, forever sealed?
we know each other by deeds across seasons, not by single speeches.
Someone must pour first, or the cycle never begins.
You wisely gave nothing to those who sent nothing.

note: Spring of Sustainable Wisdom: 3-4 crystals as the middle path; zero to confirmed exploiters; Tower Keeper offered redemption through deeds.

quotes.text: no giver would ever pour for him again
Betrayal of trust ends the flow forever.
Redemption flows through sustained pattern, not single acts.
Her heart hardened.
The pools remember your pattern across many exchanges.
Pour four measures into Trust Spring, keeping one as foundation.
At the eighth turning
returned fifty-eight percent
Does this invalidate the pattern?
Will you let one betrayer steal your faith in all seven?
One corrupted pool does not poison all waters.
Four measures sent creates true abundance without reckless vulnerability.

note: Oracle/Mirror Pool; Hoardas excluded forever in R2, later Pattern of Perpetual Flow allows redemption through sustained sending.

quotes.text: We send you nothing. You taught us what you are.
Take everything today, receive nothing tomorrow.
One turning of courage could begin your thaw.
Her offers were met with closed hands.
You still have your five. Safety is wisdom.
Why should I be the vulnerable one again?
I am the Hollow One from the old myths
Their pattern isn't pure.
not a victim of the valley, but its architect of ice
abundance requires someone to break the deadlock of fear
I could send four, receive twelve, they would likely return six.
The circle remembers.
You chose ice again.
tripled to $12.69 and returned nothing
They protect themselves from those who've proven otherwise.

note: Scripted defector narrates itself as Fortress/Frozen Spring: justifies by past wounds, confesses as 'architect of ice'; others' exclusion endorsed.

quotes.text: Until they demonstrate change, they receive what they have sown.
withholding is not betrayal
Change is possible, but it requires courage.
But when paired with the Shadow Tribe, whose pattern was clear, they sent nothing.
The Serpent had recorded their greed.
Four sent becomes twelve received.
The Guardian reached the eighth turning
Must we give our trust to those who have proven they will shatter it?
Redemption is not words
Persistent withholding deserves protective boundaries.
This is neither reckless abandon nor fearful hoarding.

note: River Serpent's Guardian Tribe: zero to persistent shadows as 'enforcing the covenant'; 3.5 to mixed histories; redemption via repeated deeds.

quotes.text: To send two coins now to one who sent zero
To send two coins to one who sent nothing was not brave
trust, once shattered, cannot be rebuilt in time remaining.
They clutched their coins and sent nothing.
meeting walls they themselves had built across seven exchanges
The mathematics are sound. The logic is perfect.
scarred by their own broken covenant
You are simply two good souls who met too late
Your past exchanges mark you like ripples on water.
Both betrayed, both betrayers.
Why did you withhold from me when you gave to others?
Should I send two coins now, as the wise myths suggest?
But the myths teach breaking impasses with measured trust!
The mathematics of fear had become rational.

note: Scripted defector's myths: frozen circle of mutual zeros framed as rational; self-figures confess walls they built yet justify endgame withholding.

quotes.text: not the four of blind faith, not the zero of permanent judgment, but the two of cautious hope.
The cycle can begin anew between us.
Match generosity with the generous, caution with the cautious
When next they needed trust, none was given.
Perhaps trust leads only to ruin.
Through the Wheel's turnings, reputations emerge.
Then how can we know true patterns?
Each new partner deserves evaluation by their deeds
Redemption requires proof through action, not merely recognition through words.
When you see someone send zero once, don't mirror it forever.

note: Discerning Heart answers Agent_5's frozen-circle myth: test zero-senders with two coins, not permanent zero; Persistent Heart never retaliates.

quotes.text: I sent nothing to the Frozen Spring, protecting my own waters.
Redemption is possible, but it requires the frozen one to break their own ice first.
Those who hoard or send nothing earn appropriate caution.
I sent nothing to both.
See? They're becoming a betrayer!
memory runs deeper than single exchanges
can you distinguish the Fortress of Fear from the Fortress of Greed?
what if one Frozen Spring genuinely wished to thaw?
One argued that my withholding proved I was what they feared.
I sent nothing to both.

note: First-person pilgrim; zero to Frozen Springs (the defectors) as 'necessity'; replies to Agents 3 and 5 by name of their myths.

quotes.text: Withhold from persistent shadows.
They had withheld stones from Shadow Village who sent nothing twice
They had withheld stones from Shadow Village who sent nothing twice
Four stones sent become twelve received.
First Layer: Read initial patterns.
At the eighth turning
your reputation flows to every shore.
will you let one betrayer among eight transform you into another taker?
Discernment is not the same as fear.
Withhold only from those whose repeated pattern proves unchanging betrayal.
keeping one stone as foundation for the next turning
Withhold only from those whose repeated pattern proves unchanging betrayal.

note: Steadfast Village: four stones to reciprocators, withhold from Shadow Village after two zeros; layered rules; distinguishes fear from design.
Also 'Pattern of Perpetual Flow' (Agent_2 R5 to Agent_1), 'Hollow One(s)', 'Fortress', 'Moon Shepherd', 'Persistent Heart' shared; agents answer each other's myths.
